entries.title: Psalms 92:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm, a Song, for the Sabbath day.>> It is good to give thanks unto Jehovah, and to sing psalms unto thy name, O Most High;

entries.title: Psalms 92:2
segments: To declare thy loving-kindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness in the nights,

entries.title: Psalms 92:3
segments: Upon an instrument of ten strings and upon the lute; upon the Higgaion with the harp.

entries.title: Psalms 92:4
segments: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work; I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

entries.title: Psalms 92:5
segments: Jehovah, how great are thy works! Thy thoughts are very deep:

entries.title: Psalms 92:6
segments: A brutish man knoweth not, neither doth a fool understand it.

entries.title: Psalms 92:7
segments: ¶When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity flourish, it is that they may be destroyed for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 92:8
segments: And thou, Jehovah, art on high for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 92:9
segments: For lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, for lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

entries.title: Psalms 92:10
segments: But my horn shalt thou exalt like a buffalo's: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

entries.title: Psalms 92:11
segments: And mine eye shall see [its desire] on mine enemies; mine ears shall hear [it] of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 92:12
segments: The righteous shall shoot forth like a palm-tree; he shall grow like a cedar on Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 92:13
segments: Those that are planted in the house of Jehovah shall flourish in the courts of our God:

entries.title: Psalms 92:14
segments: They are still vigorous in old age, they are full of sap and green;

entries.title: Psalms 92:15
segments: To shew that Jehovah is upright: [he is] my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
